titleZh: Delta浴室翻新费用2026：真实案例价格从$14,000起
contentEn:
Delta BC homeowners spent $14,000 to $43,000 on bathroom renovations in 2026, according to actual project data from completed Reno Stars builds. The wide range reflects the number of bathrooms renovated, the age of the home, and the finishes chosen. Here is what the numbers look like in practice.

What Drives Bathroom Renovation Cost in Delta

Three factors determine the price of a Delta bathroom renovation more than anything else: the number of bathrooms in the scope, the age of the home, and the material grade. A Delta townhouse built in the 1990s often reveals Poly-B plumbing once walls open — a pipe that needs replacing before tiles go in. A newer single-family home built after 2010 typically has modern plumbing already in place, which can keep the job simpler and more predictable.

  • Plumbing condition: Poly-B pipe replacement (required for most BC homes built 1985–1997) adds $3,000–$8,000 to the project
  • Structural modifications: Moving drains or walls requires a permit and licensed plumber, adding $1,500–$4,000
  • Finish grade: Basic vinyl and acrylic surrounds vs. curbless porcelain tile walk-in showers can differ by $5,000 or more

Real Project: 3.5-Bathroom Townhouse Renovation in Delta

A Delta townhouse renovation completed by Reno Stars in 2026 covered three full bathrooms and a powder room. The project took 6–8 weeks and involved updating plumbing in a townhouse complex, tiling all shower enclosures, and installing custom bathroom vanities throughout. The budget came in at $40,000–$43,000 including all labour and materials.

The project demonstrates a key advantage of renovating multiple bathrooms at once: trade mobilisation costs (plumber, electrician, tile setter) are shared across the scope, which reduces the per-bathroom cost compared to doing one bathroom at a time over separate contracts.

Permits in Delta and the Lower Mainland

Delta falls under the Metro Vancouver regional district permitting system. Bathroom renovations that involve moving plumbing fixtures, altering structural walls, or converting a bathtub to a walk-in shower typically require a building permit. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of the project management scope at no additional charge. Permit timelines in Delta are typically 5–10 business days for standard renovations.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Delta?

A single full bathroom renovation in a Delta home typically runs 3–5 weeks from demolition to final walk-through. Two-bathroom projects complete in 6–8 weeks when managed as a single contract. Reno Stars schedules inspections with the City of Delta building department and coordinates all trades to avoid gaps between phases.

FAQ: Delta Bathroom Renovation Costs

What does a small bathroom renovation cost in Delta BC?

A compact master bathroom renovation in a Delta townhouse or single-family home typically costs $14,000–$16,000 in 2026 for a basic refresh including new tub or shower, toilet, vanity, and standard finishes.

Why do bathroom renovations in older Delta townhouses cost more?

Many Delta townhouses were built between 1985 and 1997 and contain Poly-B pipe, which BC insurers increasingly require to be replaced. When walls open during a renovation, replacing Poly-B adds $3,000–$8,000 to the project scope — but it also eliminates a future leak risk.

Can I renovate two bathrooms at once to save money?

Yes. Renovating two bathrooms in one contract typically costs $2,000–$4,000 less than doing them separately because trade mobilisation, permit fees, and site setup are shared. Reno Stars completed a 3.5-bathroom townhouse renovation in Delta for $40,000–$43,000.

Does Reno Stars handle Delta building permits?

Yes. Reno Stars manages all permit applications for bathroom renovations in Delta as part of the project management fee. Permits are typically required when moving plumbing fixtures or altering walls.

What is the timeline for a full bathroom renovation in Delta?

A single full bathroom renovation takes 3–5 weeks. Two bathrooms managed as one project typically complete in 6–8 weeks. The Delta townhouse project referenced above — three full baths plus a powder room — finished in 6–8 weeks.

影响Delta浴室翻新费用的因素

三个因素对Delta浴室翻新费用的影响最大：浴室数量、房屋年龄、及材料等级。1990年代建的Delta联排别墅在打开墙壁后经常会发现Poly-B管道——这是1985年至1997年建房屋中常见的管道，BC省保险公司越来越多要求更换。2010年后建的新独立屋通常已有现代管道，翻新工程往往更简单、更可预期。

  • 管道状况：Poly-B管道更换（1985–1997年BC省住宅多数需要）需额外花费$3,000–$8,000
  • 结构改动：移动排水管或墙壁需要许可及持牌水管工，额外花费$1,500–$4,000
  • 装修等级：基础乙烯基/亚克力衬套 vs. 无障碍步入式瓷质淋浴间差距可达$5,000以上

Delta浴室翻新需要多长时间？

常见问题：Delta浴室翻新费用

Delta BC小型浴室翻新费用是多少？

Delta老旧联排别墅浴室翻新为何费用更高？

Delta许多联排别墅建于1985至1997年之间，普遍使用Poly-B管道。BC省保险公司越来越多要求更换。墙壁打开后发现需要换管时，额外花费$3,000–$8,000——但同时也消除了未来漏水的风险。

一次性翻新两间浴室可以省钱吗？

可以。同一合同翻新两间浴室比分别单独签约通常节省$2,000–$4,000，因为人工调配、许可费、场地准备可以分摊。Reno Stars在Delta完成的3.5间浴室联排别墅项目总价为$40,000–$43,000。

Reno Stars是否代办Delta的建筑许可？

是的。Reno Stars为Delta浴室翻新项目代办所有许可申请，属于项目管理费用的一部分。移动管道装置或改动墙壁通常需要许可。

Delta全浴室翻新工期是多少？

单间全浴室翻新需3–5周。作为同一合同的两间浴室翻新通常6–8周完成。以上述Delta联排别墅项目（三间全浴室+一间化妆间）为例，总工期为6–8周。
